report.summary: Chunk 4 of gated_writes.py: defines _attempt_assignment, _rev_parse_head, and gate_candidates; implements concurrent assignment execution.
risks: _attempt_assignment | medium | Uses uuid.uuid4().hex[:10] for candidate ID; collision risk negligible but not deterministic | Check if uniqueness requirement is critical and if UUID length is sufficient
_attempt_assignment | medium | Imports run_attempt inside function; may cause performance overhead on repeated calls | Measure import overhead or move to top-level
_rev_parse_head | low | Hardcoded timeout=30 seconds; may be insufficient for large repos | Verify timeout adequacy in production
_rev_parse_head | medium | Uses subprocess.run with check=False but raises RuntimeError on non-zero; error message includes stderr but may leak sensitive paths | Ensure error messages are sanitized
gate_candidates | low | Uses ThreadPoolExecutor with max_workers=max(1, max_workers); if max_workers is 0, becomes 1 | Document that max_workers=0 is treated as 1
gate_candidates | medium | model_assignments fallback to empty dict on any exception; may silently ignore configuration errors | Log or re-raise specific exceptions
gate_candidates | low | results list pre-allocated with None; if submission fails, result remains None | Ensure submission exceptions are propagated
gate_candidates | low | Iterates futs (futures dict) not as_completed; order matches assignments but blocks on slowest | Consider using as_completed for progress

handoff.purpose: Define internal helper functions _attempt_assignment, _rev_parse_head, and the public function gate_candidates for concurrent assignment gating.

symbols.name: _attempt_assignment
symbols.note: Creates runner, gate, calls run_attempt, returns GatedCandidate.

symbols.name: _rev_parse_head
symbols.note: Runs git rev-parse to get HEAD commit hash.

symbols.name: gate_candidates
symbols.note: Public function; concurrently runs assignments through TaskAttempt, returns list of GatedCandidate.

claims.text: PHASE 1: run every write Assignment through ``TaskAttempt``, concurrently.
claims.why: The function uses ThreadPoolExecutor to submit each assignment to _attempt_assignment, which calls run_attempt.

claims.text: Returns one ``GatedCandidate`` per assignment, in ``assignments`` order (not completion order).
claims.why: Results list is indexed by original order and filled as futures complete; final list preserves order.

claims.text: Never touches the primary checkout -- see module docstring.
claims.why: Module docstring not in this chunk; no evidence of checkout modification here.

claims.text: ``cancel``, when given, is forwarded to every ``TaskAttempt`` unchanged -- ``daedalus.spine.attempt._as_predicate`` normalises it (a bare callable, or anything exposing ``is_set()``, both work with no adapter here).
claims.why: The function passes cancel to _attempt_assignment, which passes to run_attempt; _as_predicate not in this chunk.

claims.text: ``None`` (the default) reproduces today's behaviour exactly: no attempt in this batch is cooperatively cancellable.
claims.why: If cancel is None, it is passed as None to run_attempt; no cancellation logic is added.

claims.text: This is deliberately request-scoped, not a module-level killswitch lookup -- a caller (e.g. a loop driver) that wants every attempt in one batch to share one cancel token passes it once, here; this module does not reach for global cancellation state on its own.
claims.why: cancel is a parameter; no global state is used for cancellation in this chunk.

claims.text: ``artifact_dir`` is optional for direct callers. ``run_write_wave`` always supplies the checkout-external content-addressed archive because it returns dictionaries rather than the live ``GatedCandidate`` objects.
claims.why: run_write_wave not in this chunk; artifact_dir is optional as it has a default of None.

claims.text: Resolve model assignments against the PRIMARY checkout. The isolated worktree is cut from committed HEAD and therefore (correctly) excludes dirty policy edits; letting offload rediscover the assignment there silently changed Lucia's measured 14B run back to the .env default.
claims.why: References primary checkout and isolated worktree; not verifiable from this chunk alone.

observations.what: Function _attempt_assignment generates a 10-hex-digit ID via uuid.uuid4().hex[:10] for the spec.
Function _attempt_assignment calls _spec_for with gate and model parameters.
Function _attempt_assignment optionally adds 'rewrite_windows' from gate config to runner_kwargs.
Function _attempt_assignment selects gate function based on spec.gate_argv: _curated_relay_gate if present, else _relay_gate.
Function _attempt_assignment calls run_attempt with keep_worktree=False, reap=True.
Function _rev_parse_head runs 'git rev-parse --verify HEAD' with a 30-second timeout.
Function _rev_parse_head raises RuntimeError if git command fails.
gate_candidates requires gates list length to match assignments length if provided.
gate_candidates falls back to resolve_spine_db_path if ledger_path is None.
gate_candidates uses _rev_parse_head if base_commit is None.
gate_candidates resolves model_assignments from primary_data via resolve_project, with fallback to empty dict on exception.
gate_candidates uses ThreadPoolExecutor with max_workers=max(1, max_workers).
gate_candidates submits all assignments to pool and collects results in order.
gate_candidates passes model from model_assignments per assignment owner if available.
